ideas.idea: Give each product its own page with price and description, with full Product data
ideas.why: /shop only has a one-line paragraph and a bare Product schema, so per-product pages would give real content to read.

ideas.idea: Add a shipping section (cutoff time, regions) in page text, since the delivery info is only in a data-nosnippet block
ideas.why: The next-day claim in the h1 is backed only by a data-nosnippet notice, so visible detail would support it.

ideas.idea: Add a description to the /search page
ideas.why: The page is deliberately noindex, so the report's own note that it only matters if noindex is removed makes this low-value advice on a deliberate choice.

ideas.idea: Add Organization/WebSite structured data in the layout
ideas.why: The site has no entity markup, and the store name and URL could be added once in the shared layout.

ideas.idea: Add a viewport meta tag in app.html
ideas.why: app.html has a charset but no viewport, so mobile rendering is affected; this is accurate and a concrete fix.
No page has social tags, but this is standard advice for almost any site and has small effect on being found.

ideas.idea: Wrap page content in a <main> element in the layout
ideas.why: The layout has no main landmark, and adding one helps tools and readers locate the primary content.
This is accurate but minor, applies to almost any sitemap, and the report itself hedges it on having real update dates.

ideas.idea: Generate the sitemap from routes once product pages exist
ideas.why: With two URLs the static file is fine, and this is advice for a future state that applies to most sites.

ideas.idea: Fill the /shop meta description with text like 'Bilge pumps, cleats and rope for boats'
ideas.why: This is the same as the known empty-description problem, so it adds only example wording.

ideas.idea: Sitemap lists /shop but robots.txt blocks Googlebot, so remove the Googlebot block
ideas.why: This is a consequence of the known Googlebot block, so it adds nothing new.
